mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a coordinated policy response to economic weakness, which typically triggers a short-term equity market rebound over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising CPIAUCSL), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to higher real interest rates and reduced corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a supply shock with labor market strength, which typically causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by high industrial production growth), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 5 trading days due to overvaluation and profit-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
